install_order: ha-v1.0.0rc5 (HACS, then a Home Assistant restart)
v1.0.0-e32v2-rc.4 (Home Assistant Firmware update entity, one Install press), attended, with the owner at home, with pre- and post-install capture as the acceptance receipt (tools/acceptance)
confirm the takeover again right after the update (Repairs, or Rooms on the E32); until then the E32 keeps only frost protection
publication_condition: the owner's explicit go with the one-time exception over the unaccepted rc.3 (recorded) and green exact-tag CI
changes: L1 FlowLearner: cooling segments pause over a store boiler's keep-warm rounds instead of restarting, so the heat-loss model is learned

L2 ArrivalLearner: every applied warm-up start is judged at the switch time (late > 10 min: lead factor x1.10, early > 15 min: x0.92, 0.5..2.0), kept per room id in LearnedState, shown as plan.arrival

L3 FlowPolicy: a default-confidence start is applied as an estimate from the current room temperature, capped at 3 h (floor) / 90 min (radiator) until the arrival feedback is trusted; every room with a planned start is served; the start's own rest after arrival
L4 FlowLearner: one filled flow bin times the warm-up (readiness_timing); the lowest flow still needs two
L5 AutoTuner: day counters in the NVS record (hourly), 2 h boot grace with a restored record, a restart only on control changes of the plan, rooms re-keyed by id

F1 Scoreboard: per local day heating hours, starts per heating hour, short-cycle hours, heating kWh, degree-days and per room arrival error and overshoot, in /status/heating and heating_summary, kept over a restart
F2 DhwEpisodes: hot water today and the last 7 days survive a restart; the adapter's zero boiler counters are hidden
F3 E32 Overview: why each room heats, in Home Assistant's words, with presence and window icons
F4 E32 Overview: one Heating on/off label, at most two labels on a phone
F5 Frequent burner starts shown as learning information with the self-tuning step, not as a warning
F6 E32 pages: Weather compensation and Water temperature in hard frost (-10 C)
F7 Learned card in two lines per room with More, Sign out in the System menu, 10 % chart margin

F8 Holiday planner: up to 8 planned holidays with their own holiday temperature, on the Home page and in Home Assistant; the house returns to its previous mode; warm-up before the return; own NVS record; rc.3's dated away converted once
F9 E32 Overview shows the E32's own rooms also without Home Assistant (page only)
